info.title: Chatwoot application API (curated)
info.description: The handful of Chatwoot application-API operations realm-chatwoot's producers use, scoped to ONE account: the account id is part of the server URL, because it is a fact about the install and not about any request.

ChatwootAccessToken.name: api_access_token
ChatwootAccessToken.description: A user's access token (Profile settings -> Access Token). Reads see what that user may see.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Narrows at the source (verified: all 37, open 21, resolved 16 on the demo book). Chatwoot's default is `open`, so say `all` to mean it.

parameters.name: assignee_type
parameters.description: Chatwoot's default is `me`-biased counts; `all` is the whole desk.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: `created_at_asc` gives a STABLE order. The default orders by last activity, which moves while pages are being read.

200.description: data.payload is the page; data.meta.all_count the total

post.summary: Conversations matching attribute filters, one page of 25

payload.description: Filter clauses. NOTE `values` is NOT an IN-list: given two values Chatwoot matches only the first (verified), so ask one value per call.

200.description: payload is the page; meta.all_count the total
